Checklists

Traveling

Documents

  • Passport
  • Microchip
  • Vaccinations
  • CertificatesAllow extra time for possible checks by a specialist right at the airport.

Items

  • Carrier
  • Water
  • Food and snacks
  • Absorbent pads
  • A toy with a familiar scent
  • Prepare medicationsDepending on your cat's needs.
  • Get calming pheromones or a calming collar.

Not a substitute for a vet

The information in this app comes from open sources and the experience of cat owners. It does not replace a consultation or an examination by a vet. Decisions about your pet's health and care are the owner's to make — if in any doubt, contact a vet.
